opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society (Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow). Postgraduate, Full and Fellow applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend. Awards can only be used to attend Society meetings (all categories) and Society-sponsored meetings (Postgraduate, Full and Fellow Members).
opportunities.summary: Funding primarily to support member engagement at the Society's own meetings and, where funding allows, attendance at Society-sponsored events. Covers conference registration and attendance at meeting dinners, plus a contribution toward advanced standard travel and accommodation up to the total award value. Members can apply to attend up to three meetings in one application.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award. Applications for 2026 are closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education. Funds must be used within 12 months of the award date.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award. Applications for 2026 are closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Animal costs, experimental consumables and small equipment purchases (excluding PCs) are permitted. Funds must be used within 12 months of the award date.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Society Representatives and members; applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow. Funding cannot be used for salary costs, conference attendance or membership payments.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events. The next application round is now open.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers. The next application round is now open.
opportunities.summary: Provides additional support to postdoctoral researchers to help them achieve their full potential. Funds should be used within 12 months of receipt. Funds cannot be used to pay staff salaries but may be used for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship or other justifiable sundries.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible applicants must be an Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow of The Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer. Applications have closed for 2026 and will reopen in 2027.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address the principles of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion. Intended for projects that directly investigate or address inclusion and diversity issues in the physiological sciences in either teaching or research. Funds must be used within 6 months of the award date.
